item.title: New benchmarks show the iPhone chip in the cut-price Apple MacBook Neo beating every single x86 PC processor for single-core performance
item.content:encoded: And it's not even Apple's fastest phone chip.

item.title: No one at Embark could describe Arc Raiders before its extraction shooter pivot, leading to 'playtest battles' of competing directions for the game
item.content:encoded: "A lot of games would have been cancelled at this point."

item.title: 'There is no scenario where memory prices correct in the second half' of 2027, according to new market research
item.content:encoded: It's times like these we'll long to forget.

item.title: This horror game where you're a conscious nuclear missile boasts 'one handed mouse only controls', leaving me with assumptions that proved incorrect when I had to saw my own limbs off
item.content:encoded: Brainshell's demo made me do awful things to myself.

item.title: Dispatch's character and concept artist was picked up on ArtStation 'as a last resort', a temporary solution 'to get us through the pitch phase', before defining the entire game's artstyle
item.content:encoded: Emergency call.

item.title: Bluepoint tech boss suggests Sony's scared of Valve, not Microsoft, and that's why it's pulling back from PC: 'It would be quite ironic if Valve ultimately ended up winning the console war'
item.content:encoded: Me? I just think everyone's intimidated by the raw power and magnetism of Linux.

item.title: Game dev union members marched at GDC to propose a 'Game Workers' Bill of Rights'
item.content:encoded: The UVW-CWA is envisioning a base standard set of working conditions for all game developers.

item.title: Asus thinks 'high-end brand value and high-end product mix' will help it weather the memory crisis alongside AI
item.content:encoded: AI giveth and AI taketh away.

item.title: Ever complained about Overwatch matchmaking? There's a chance Jeff Kaplan checked your account and all he has to say is: 'There's gotta be winners and there's gotta be losers'
item.content:encoded: In short: git gud.

item.title: Garry's Mod creator says programmers over-relying on AI is like using too much porn: 'You lose your ability to ejaculate using your imagination'
item.content:encoded: However, Facepunch Studios founder Garry Newman does use AI regularly: "It makes my job so much easier."

item.title: A terrible quest in vanilla WoW 'holds a really special place in my heart', says Jeff Kaplan, but was also 'the hubris of a junior game designer who thinks he's clever but is actually a dipsh*t'
item.content:encoded: "I'm just sh*tting up their inventory with all these pages."

item.title: One of Jeff Kaplan's 'regrets about Overwatch' was making it so team-orientated: 'I would downplay the team factor and try to put more focus on individual contribution'
item.content:encoded: The worst part of multiplayer games are all the other players.

item.title: Texture pop-in may be about to pop-out of existence thanks to even faster asset streaming ushered in by new Zstandard support in DirectStorage
item.content:encoded: Racing ahead.

item.title: Modder behind cancelled Star Wars game's unofficial revival has 'no concern at all' about Disney reprisal: 'We pose little to no threat to any upcoming or ongoing titles'
item.content:encoded: "Ultimately any Star Wars game more than deserves preservation and restoration."

item.title: AMD announces next-gen 'FSR Diamond' AI-enhanced upscaling for future Xbox consoles, but the question is whether it's coming to PC and which GPUs will support it
item.content:encoded: And will it be limited to next-gen RDNA 5 GPUs?

item.title: PlayerUnknown reckons he can take back the term 'metaverse' because 'It's just been co-opted by certain people… like, I still use Twitter because f**k [Elon Musk]'
item.content:encoded: Them's fighting words.

item.title: Microsoft is paving more PC roads to Project Helix, releasing a Windows 11 Xbox Mode in April for laptops and desktops
item.content:encoded: This should make navigating Windows on controller easier.

item.title: WoW's Horde/Alliance split was 'really controversial', says Jeff Kaplan, to the point where it was only locked in 9-12 months before the game's launch
item.content:encoded: "He liked the fact you were instantly on a team."

item.title: Mewgenics will have 'at least two' DLCs, and the 'small' one is almost a third as big as the base game
item.content:encoded: Never hitting paws.

item.title: Dawn of War 4 playtesters want the combat to take longer because of how much they enjoy watching it
item.content:encoded: "Because we really want to see all these sync-kills and all the sync-melee combat that you guys have got going on."

item.title: Overwatch co-creator Jeff Kaplan on his exit from Activision Blizzard: 'It was the biggest f**k you moment I've had in my career'
item.content:encoded: Overwatch League was instrumental in sending Overwatch off the rails.

item.title: How well do you know Baldur's Gate 3's second act? You may need an actual brainworm to score a perfect 20/20 on our latest quiz
item.content:encoded: No cheating, or I'm telling Selûne.

item.title: The latest Humble Bundle packs 9 CRPGs, including some of the best to ever do it, for a little over $20
item.content:encoded: It includes Baldur's Gate 2, Planescape Torment, the new Pathfinder games, and more.

item.title: The Blood Bowl update, using the tabletop game's latest rules, will be a separate game called Warhammer Blood Bowl 'free for all players who already own Blood Bowl 3'
item.content:encoded: You'll get to transfer over any teams and other stuff you've unlocked.

item.title: Dispatch doesn't let you derail conversations with blank, vacant stares because 'less than 1%' of players ever chose to stay silent in Telltale games
item.content:encoded: Unfortunately, weaponized awkwardness still takes up development resources.

item.title: Valve says New York Attorney General's violent videogame fearmongering is 'a distraction and a mischaracterization we’ve all heard before'
item.content:encoded: The New York AG seems to be trying to stir up fears about violent videogames as the state pursues legal action against Valve, but Valve isn't having it.

item.title: Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred's new crafting system will bring back season 11's sanctification and gives bad loot the potential to be legendary
item.content:encoded: One man's trash is another man's legendary item.

item.title: Valve comes out swinging against New York lawsuit with rare public statement: 'The type of deal that would satisfy the NYAG would have been bad for users and other game developers'
item.content:encoded: The state of New York sued Valve in February over allegations of illegal gambling.

item.title: Overhauling Minecraft's world generation was like 'trying to build a skyscraper with hand tools' which basically scared Mojang off of continuing massive yearly updates
item.content:encoded: Mojang got so in over its head overhauling all of Minecraft's world generation tech five years ago that it swore off yearly title updates not long after.

item.title: Valve says almost 6,000 games made over $100K on Steam last year
item.content:encoded: And "if you have a line on a bunch of RAM, we are in the market and would like to buy it."

item.title: Microsoft spills the beans on its Xbox-PC hybrid at GDC while suggesting it's still years away
item.content:encoded: The AMD-powered box will continue the work started by the ROG Ally X.

item.title: Even among the crowd of gorgeous illustrated games, At Fate's End is stunning enough to stand out
item.content:encoded: Sword-centric demigod sibling drama never looked so good.

item.title: 'We are definitely not doing QTEs', said Dispatch's creative director before doing QTEs: 'We just needed it to not suck'
item.content:encoded: What came first? The dispatching minigame or the Z-Team?

item.title: Valve clarifies what's required for a game to be Steam Machine and Steam Frame verified, but it just makes me worry about the Gabecube even more
item.content:encoded: Still, its advice for games being made with SteamOS in mind is all top-notch.

item.title: One of my favourite 4K OLED monitors just got updated with Samsung's latest Tandem OLED panel tech
item.content:encoded: The only bit that's missing is the 'RGB stripe'...

item.title: Asus CFO Nick Wu thinks Apple's MacBook Neo is 'certainly a shock to the entire market'
item.content:encoded: A $600 MacBook would have been unusual even without the RAMpocalypse.

item.title: Meta bought Moltbook, an almost entirely AI-populated social media platform, for we don't know how much—and we're not completely sure why yet, either
item.content:encoded: Clawing back AI talent.

item.title: Cancelled LucasArts Star Wars shooter that 'would have just made Disney money' is playable online for the first time
item.content:encoded: "Dev costs were done" when First Assault was cancelled in 2013.

item.title: In an amazing live mash-up, composer Austin Wintory turned Ben Starr's Clair Obscur monologue into a Balatro gag
item.content:encoded: Jimbo's revenge.

item.title: Former Highguard dev who called out grave-dancing over the reveal trailer says the discourse 'had some very dark corners that may have accelerated the timeline of our failure,' but adds, 'it wasn't the primary cause'
item.content:encoded: Highguard closes for good tomorrow, less than two months after it launched.

item.title: Pragmata's demo reaches 2 million downloads alongside its 2 million wishlists: 'I can't believe millions of people are excited for our game'
item.content:encoded: We're about a month out from release and it's looking good.

item.title: More than 15 years after it was revealed to the world, the game once envisioned as Crytek's big move into the online military shooter scene is finally closing
item.content:encoded: My.Games is pulling the plug on two online shooters with two very different histories.

item.title: This year's Overwatch April Fool's event is a two week Underwatch mode which throws 'common sense off the nearest ledge'
item.content:encoded: "Physics will follow no rules."

item.title: Dark Messiah modders given 'blank check' from Ubisoft to develop toolkit are now releasing a Community Edition of Arkane's classic
item.content:encoded: Let the booting continue indefinitely.

item.title: Dispatch directors chose their animators because they'd made a 'really cool apple juice commercial'
item.content:encoded: "We could kind of squint and start to see Dispatch for the first time."

item.title: Intel announces Arrow Lake 'Plus' desktop chips with more cores and clocks for less cash—and IPC-boosting 'BOT' tool
item.content:encoded: As refreshes go, this isn't actually half bad.

item.title: EarFun Air Pro 4+ review
item.content:encoded: A true step-up in mid-range earbud sound quality.

item.title: Thermaltake Minecube 360 Ultra ARGB Sync review
item.content:encoded: Four screens, good performance, high price.

item.title: Memory prices could leap even higher as the supply of helium, crucial to making chips, is now impacted by the conflict in the Middle East
item.content:encoded: There's no quick fix to getting hold of ultra-pure helium, either.

item.title: Microsoft shows support for Anthropic's legal case against the US Department of Defense
item.content:encoded: Friends in high places.
